key_findings: Starting pitcher does NOT dominate the way a hockey goalie does: ~1/3 of run prevention vs a goalie's 100% of leverage, and already efficiently priced.
Never use ERA - SIERA/xFIP beat it at predicting next-season ERA. K% stabilises ~70 batters faced, BB% ~170, FIP ~400.
Individual batter platoon splits need ~1000 PA vs the minority hand - always use league-average platoon regressed, never raw.
Single-season park factors are noise; 3-year rolling minimum.
Wind DIRECTION matters far more than speed, and MLB StatsAPI gives it free.

key_findings: TURNOVER MARGIN MUST BE USED INVERTED: fumble recovery is ~50/50 with no demonstrated team skill, so a big positive margin flags an OVERVALUED team.
Defensive EPA stabilises materially slower than offensive EPA (~11-13 games vs ~8-10). Weighting them equally is a modelling error.
Red-zone TD% and 3rd-down conversion are among the most mean-reverting stats in football - use as a FADE flag, never a forward predictor.
Pressure rate is the stable input; sack rate is the noisy output that regresses toward it.
17 games carries roughly the signal of 15 baseball games. Below 4 games team stats are uninformative.
Wind >15-20mph is the ONLY reliably total-suppressing weather variable (~-1.5 to -2.5 pts).
NCAA has NO mandated injury report - NCAA QB status cannot be modelled from public data.
